svg.title: Release, when you start it
svg.desc: The steps in order, with who does each. You: start Release prep in Kitden's Actions; Gather: what changed since the last tag; Claude: drafts the release notes, README, policy; Prepare: sets the version, records the README pictures; Beacon: opens the pull request Kitden X.Y.Z; You: review it, edit if you like, merge; Beacon: tags vX.Y.Z; Build, test: then PyPI and GitHub release; Beacon: release branch, Homebrew PR; MCP Registry: and a table of every store; Kettle: keeps Homebrew up to date; Lantern: an issue if a store is behind.
